title: CSV export and import of assets
interface: export_assets_csv(assets: AssetRepository, tags: TagRepository) -> str: UTF-8 text with header asset_tag;type;brand;model;serial_number;status;condition;location;tags;holder_email;warranty_until;supplier;cost_center;invoice;purchase_date;price;notes (delimiter ';'), rows from assets.search_assets() (location = location_name or '', tags joined with '|', holder_email or '', invoice = the invoice number looked up via assets.conn: SELECT number FROM invoices WHERE id=? or ''). import_assets_csv(service: AssetService, locations: LocationRepository, actor: str, text: str) -> dict {'created', 'updated', 'errors': [str]}: delimiter ';' or ',' (csv.Sniffer, fallback ';'), header required; asset_tag required; existing tag (service.assets.get_by_tag) -> service.update with the given columns, else service.create (type required for create); 'location' name -> locations.get_by_name or locations.create(name); 'tags' split on '|' -> tag_names; 'invoice' -> invoice_number; price float; every row error is collected as 'řádek N: <message>' (N = 1-based line number in the file, header = 1) and processing continues. Never catch generic Exception except to record a row error from AssetValidationError/DuplicateAssetTag/ValueError.

uses.AssetRepository: src/repositories/assets.py (attribute conn; search_assets rows have location_name, holder_email)
